coverage_note: Reviewed the full 27-text-file application tree. The repository is a Next.js demo using the external @vapi-ai/web SDK, not a reusable implementation of that SDK. Retained the application package, lifecycle hook, assistant configuration, domain UI components and webhook boundary. Framework shell pages, stock button, utility/type/config files and static show data are implementation details. Booking is simulated by UI state; no payment or ticket-provider execution exists.

scoped_review.conclusion: Static review establishes a voice demo rather than a payment or booking engine. Browser and webhook paths log conversation payloads, and the webhook lacks authorization and input validation. Retain as a reference with explicit deployment warnings; add verification, redaction, real fulfillment and failure handling before production. No source code was executed.
